Sonatype OSS Index

Known vulnerabilities for a dependency inventory, from the public Sonatype OSS Index API

skills/toil/ossindex.md

Known vulnerabilities for the packages in a dependency inventory, from the public Sonatype OSS Index API (https://ossindex.sonatype.org). It reads only. Verification level: unit.

Supported versions: OSS Index REST API v3 or later

Credential

OSS Index requires a free account: anonymous requests get HTTP 401. Sign up at https://ossindex.sonatype.org, then copy the API token from your account settings. toil sends your username and that token as HTTP Basic auth, and only ever to https://ossindex.sonatype.org: the host is fixed, because the command names the service, so there’s no baseUrl setting.

Configuration

KeyEnv varRequiredMeaning
usernameTOIL_OSSINDEX_USERNAMEyesYour OSS Index username (the email address you signed up with)
tokenTOIL_OSSINDEX_TOKENyesYour OSS Index API token
export TOIL_OSSINDEX_USERNAME=you@example.com
export TOIL_OSSINDEX_TOKEN=<your API token>

Or add a connection with toil connections add ossindex --area ossindex, which keeps the token in the OS credential store. A plaintext token in the config file is refused with CONFIG_INVALID. With neither set, the command fails with NOT_CONFIGURED before sending anything. toil uses HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY and NO_PROXY when they’re set.

Commands

toil ossindex vulns

Checks an inventory, a JSON list of packages, against OSS Index. MCP tool: ossindex_vulns.

echo '[{"name":"lodash","version":"4.17.20","ecosystem":"npm"}]' > inventory.json
toil ossindex vulns --from inventory.json
toil ossindex vulns --from inventory.json --ecosystem maven
FlagMeaning
--from <file>A JSON file holding a list of { name, version, ecosystem } packages (ecosystem is npm, nuget or maven; Maven names are group:artifact). Optional type (direct/transitive) and scope (production/dev) feed the filters below. toil deps scan output (its envelope or its data) is accepted too, so `toil deps scan
--ecosystem <ecosystem>npm, nuget, maven or all (default). Any other value matches nothing and returns a clean result
--direct-onlyLeave out packages the inventory marks transitive
--include-devKeep packages the inventory marks dev (left out by default)

It first checks OSS Index answers (an empty list of coordinates), then sends POST /api/v3/component-report with up to 128 package URLs a request, one request after another: pkg:npm/%40scope/name@1.0.0, pkg:nuget/Name@1.0.0, pkg:maven/<group>/<artifact>@1.0.0. Reports are matched back by their exact coordinates; one OSS Index returns in another form is dropped.

Output is the same shape deps frisk --source sonatype had, so source is sonatype:

{
  "tier": "full", "source": "sonatype", "sourcesQueried": ["sonatype"], "sourceErrors": [],
  "scanned": 4, "vulnerable": 1,
  "packages": [{
    "name": "org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core", "version": "2.14.1", "ecosystem": "maven", "source": "pom.xml", "type": "direct", "scope": "production",
    "vulnerabilities": [{
      "id": "CVE-2021-44228", "summary": "[CVE-2021-44228] Improper input validation", "severity": "CRITICAL", "cvss": 10,
      "aliases": ["CVE-2021-44228"],
      "remediation": { "fixAvailable": false, "fixedVersions": [], "advice": "See https://ossindex.sonatype.org/vulnerability/CVE-2021-44228 for remediation details for org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core@2.14.1." },
      "references": ["https://ossindex.sonatype.org/vulnerability/CVE-2021-44228"]
    }]
  }]
}

id is the vulnerability’s display name, severity comes from its CVSS score (9 CRITICAL, 7 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, above 0 LOW, else UNKNOWN), and aliases are the CVE ids found in its name, title and description. OSS Index gives no fixed versions, so fixAvailable is always false.

Errors

  • INVALID_INPUT: the inventory isn’t JSON, is a failed result, has no packages list, or has a package without a name, version or ecosystem. Nothing is sent.
  • NOT_CONFIGURED: no OSS Index account is set up; set TOIL_OSSINDEX_USERNAME and TOIL_OSSINDEX_TOKEN.
  • AUTH: OSS Index rejected the username and token.
  • NETWORK: “toil ossindex vulns requires Sonatype OSS Index access but ossindex.sonatype.org is not reachable from this machine.” The reachability check failed; error.details.cause says how.
  • HTTP: “Sonatype OSS Index is rate-limiting requests from this IP…” on a 429. The limit is per account; wait and retry.
  • HTTP: Sonatype OSS Index returned HTTP <status> <reason> for any other failed batch.

Alias paths

deps frisk --source sonatype runs toil ossindex vulns, with the same --ecosystem, --direct-only, --include-dev and --from flags.

Settings at a glance

    OSS Index account username (the email address you signed up with)

    TOIL_OSSINDEX_TOKEN
